title: DispatchRecord
description: Written parent-side at ~/.dev-team/state/<repo-slug>/<task-slug>/dispatch/<stem>.json. Schema evolution: every file carries schema_version, starting at 1. A reader that encounters a schema_version higher than the one it knows REFUSES the document — it never best-efforts; the validator reports this as a distinctly named schema_version_too_new violation. Adding a value to an enum bumps schema_version if and only if some consumer branches on that enum with a documented default or else path. No bump: tools, profile.allow grants, permission_mode, isolation, agent, return.kind. Bump: outcome, level, escalate_to, postcondition. When in doubt, bump. This record is written parent-side and is not reachable by a worker's tool calls; a Bash subprocess can nonetheless read parent-side state (G13). The completion nonce (ADR-003 Am. 1) MUST NOT appear in this record in any field, including free-text fields; it is delivered via ~/.dev-team/state/<repo-slug>/<task-slug>/<dispatch_id>.nonce, mode 0600, read-and-unlinked by the adapter before claude exists. The nonce PATH is likewise prohibited from this record, and the completion-nonce prefix is the frozen constant devteam-done- so writer and argv builder can both assert by substring scan over the serialized bytes. Lifecycle: three states, two permitted transitions — create (T0, before pane creation) then bind (T1, after cmux new-pane returns ids: surface and bound_at set) then terminate (T2: outcome and ended_at set). Each transition is written atomically (tmp file plus rename) and is MONOTONE: null becomes set, never set becomes null and never set becomes a different value. Every other field is byte-identical across all three states, and dispatch_id is never reused. profile.allow's grammar is agent-specific and discriminated by `agent`. Four parent-side sidecar file formats, keyed by dispatch_id under ~/.dev-team/state/<repo-slug>/<task-slug>/: <dispatch_id>.exit is the child's decimal exit code; <dispatch_id>.gate is the Stop gate's decimal block counter; <dispatch_id>.nonce is mode 0600, read-and-unlinked; <dispatch_id>.signal-log is one attested JSON line per observed signal write. All four are writable by a worker's Bash subprocess (same uid); each one's blast radius is bounded because completion is re-derived from the ladder on every wake. returns/<stem>.md is written by the PARENT after validation, for doc-tab display, and is covered by no grant — the human's viewport is a file no worker can write. Residual: sibling workers can read each other's returns/ and signals/ content under --add-dir; no token or credential lives in those files.

profile.description: The COMPOSED profile. `allow`'s grammar is AGENT-SPECIFIC and discriminated by the top-level `agent` field, while `grants` carries the agent-neutral intent it expanded from. `allow` MUST contain both of these literals byte-identically, in every composed profile including judgment and validator: Bash(cmux notify *) and Bash(cmux wait-for -S *).

grants.description: The agent-neutral tokens this expanded from.

schema_path.description: The PLUGIN-ROOT source schema (D-1), never a path under the per-dispatch snapshot; null when kind is markdown.

spec_path.description: <task_dir>/spec/<slice_id>.json (no attempt — the spec is per slice)

worktree.description: Worktree path is <task_artifacts_root>/worktrees/<repo-slug>/<task-slug>/<slice_id>, keyed to slice_id (never task_id), reused across attempts of the same slice, and rooted outside every checkout. Null if and only if isolation is "primary".

path.description: Must not equal primary_checkout (relation not schema-expressible; asserted by the 1b builder test).

source_slice_id.description: Null if and only if created_by_dispatcher is true; names the slice whose worktree this dispatch inspects.

env.description: Closed, exactly eight keys, ALL required, all values strings. Each key is justified by exactly one worker-side hook consumer; DEVTEAM_STATE_DIR is deliberately omitted, but not for location secrecy — DEVTEAM_GATE_COUNTER already discloses that same directory, so a worker's Bash subprocess can already list it (G13). The omission's actual value is least privilege over WHICH files each hook is handed (its one file, never the state root as a whole); nonce confidentiality is lifetime-bounded (read-and-unlinked before the worker's own process exists, Rider E), never location-bounded. Adding a ninth key is a deliberate schema_version event.

attn_upstream.description: Equals attn_parent for an orchestrator-initiated dispatch.

kickoff.description: Single line handed to the worker at pane start. Must carry dispatch_id, task_dir, spec_path, return_path, signals_path, attn_parent and attn_upstream as expanded absolute literals — the record is parent-side, so the kickoff is the worker's only reliable channel for its own dispatch identity and paths. Must never contain the completion-nonce prefix devteam-done-.

surface.description: Null in state create, set at bind. The UUID pattern makes a positional reference such as surface:9 structurally unrepresentable.
